one_liner_zh: 新思科技上一季 EPS 超預期11.6%，營收2.41億美元，EDA 動能穩健。
one_liner_en: Synopsys beat EPS by 11.6% with $2.41B revenue, on steady EDA momentum.
beat_or_miss: 超預期：EPS 較預估高出11.61%，獲利優於市場共識。
ai_view_zh: 訊號偏正面：EPS 超預期，反映新思在 EDA 與 IP 領域的領導地位與穩定執行。本季營收年增率未揭露，但 EDA 需求受 AI 晶片設計驅動，結構性向上。短期業績支撐股價，中期關鍵在 Ansys 併購整合綜效兌現與多物理模擬布局。追蹤指標：訂單背書、營收年增、Ansys 整合進度與 non-GAAP 利潤率。105倍本益比下，市場對連續執行與綜效兌現要求極高，估值容錯空間極小。
ai_view_en: Signal is positive: an EPS beat reflects Synopsys's leadership in EDA and IP with steady execution. Revenue YoY was undisclosed, but EDA demand driven by AI chip design is structurally up. Near-term earnings support the stock; mid-term hinges on realizing Ansys integration synergies and building out multiphysics simulation. Track backlog, revenue growth, Ansys integration progress, and non-GAAP margin. At 105x, the market demands consistent execution and synergy delivery with minimal margin for error.
highlights_zh: 營收2.41億美元（B級），規模穩固。
晶片設計複雜度提升持續推動 EDA 需求。
本益比105.52，市場給予高成長與龍頭溢價。
highlights_en: EPS of $0.34 beat the $0.30 estimate by 11.61%.
Revenue of $2.41B held a solid scale.
Rising chip-design complexity keeps driving EDA demand.
P/E of 105.52 reflects a high-growth and leadership premium.
risks_zh: 營收年增率未提供，成長趨勢需後續確認。
極高估值對任何獲利失速高度敏感。
Ansys 併購整合的執行風險。
risks_en: Revenue YoY was not provided, requiring later confirmation.
A very high valuation is highly sensitive to any earnings stall.
